objective: Proof: the model count for any odd ring with spare distinctions, its recurrence and rate; the ring of five five-place knots as 5 F(t+2); why rings of four and six degenerate.
status: Proved 2026-11-18 (referee pending): for odd rings of n >= 5 knots with j spare distinctions the model's count satisfies c(t) = sum_i C(j,i) c(t-n-i), rate the root of x^(n+j) = (1+x)^j; with a spare at every knot c(t) = n F(t+2) every round; rings of three, four and six degenerate.
title: The ring formula
